xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5486: Bot integrations: stamp the core version pins at release, and make the Grok Bot docs agree with the live result

plan.title: Bot integrations: stamp the core version pins at release, and make the Grok Bot docs agree with the live result
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue is a consistency fix whose surface is wide but shallow: four one-line pin stamps, four verification.md sections, three doc pages and a two-line dialog change, each its own small item. The projected-surface lint counts subsystems by the first two path segments, so integrations/<platform> alone yields five subsystems; splitting Part 1 from Part 2 into sibling issues would still leave each over the 6-subsystem limit (Part 2 alone touches configuration/, integrations/grok-bot, grok-build, hermes, openclaw and src/dashboard). The operator filed it as one issue to run on one cheaper model.

narratives.Problem: Part 1: the @overdeck/core version each bot plugin installs is typed by hand in four places (grok-build run-mcp.sh and README at 0.74.0, grok-bot mcp.json and README at 0.77.0) while the root package is 0.90.1; nothing writes or checks them. Part 2: configuration/bots.mdx, configuration/mcp.mdx, integrations/grok-bot/README.md and the Connect a bot dialog present the connector as Grok Bot's default route, but the only live run (PAN-5242, 2026-11-14) failed three times because Grok Bot's sandbox has no WebRTC egress, and Public MCP with Grok Bot has never been run live.
narratives.Proposal: Add integrations/shared/sync-core-pins.mjs (modeled on sync-skill.mjs): it rewrites every numeric @overdeck/core@ pin and the OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION default under integrations/ to the root package.json version, and --check exits 1 on drift. Stamp the pins once, make the existing tests derive the pin from package.json, run --check in the integrations CI job and as a repository-level unit test, and call it from pan release (stable and canary) through an exported stampCorePins helper with staging and rollback. Then make the four Grok Bot surfaces say the same thing: Public MCP is the route (and the dialog default), the connector route fails from Grok Bot's sandbox (PAN-5242), and Public MCP with Grok Bot is not verified live; add dated 'Changes since 2026-11-04' sections to every verification.md without marking anything passed. PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-5486.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running Grok Bot live over Public MCP (that is PAN-5058 checkpoint CP-1; PAN-5058 W-5 updates the four surfaces afterwards).
- Changing integrations/grok-bot/mcp.json from the stdio connector config to a URL config.
- Removing the Overdeck connector reach for Grok Bot from the dialog.
- Editing ConnectBotOutput.tsx (PAN-5058 W-5 owns its dated note).
- Editing .github/workflows/release.yml (its full-suite gate already runs the repository-level pin test).
- Using @latest or version ranges in any pin.
- Marking any verification row Passed without a dated live run.
- Publishing any plugin to npm, PyPI or a plugin catalog.
- #5028, #5029, #5033.

autoDecisions.summary: The connector route is kept as a second reach for Grok Bot; Public MCP becomes the default (reaches ['public', 'connector']) with a warning on the connector reach.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says Public MCP is the route to use and the bots.mdx row must drop 'connector (default)'; that table describes the dialog's default, so the dialog must change too. Keeping the reach is reversible and matches PAN-5058 W-5's fail-branch rule ('reaches keeps both routes').

autoDecisions.summary: Both pan release stable and pan release canary stamp the pins, and the regexes accept a prerelease suffix.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI compares pins with the root version and canary also writes it, so stamping only on stable would turn main red after a canary release.

autoDecisions.summary: No release.yml change; FR-2/FR-3 are enforced by a ci.yml step, a repository-level unit test, and the release command itself.
autoDecisions.rationale: release.yml already runs the full suite on the tag, which includes the repository-level pin test; fewer workflow edits means fewer SSH-only pushes.

autoDecisions.summary: The sync script finds pins by pattern across integrations/ rather than from a file list.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks that pins the table misses be covered too; a pattern catches any future hand-typed pin, and the digit-only match leaves @<version>/@<pin> placeholders alone.

autoDecisions.summary: integrations/grok-bot/mcp.json stays the stdio connector config, and the Grok Bot README moves the connector flow under a heading that says it fails from the sandbox.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue keeps mcp.json under the pin sync and does not ask to change it; PAN-5072 chose stdio on purpose, and the Public MCP steps already say to replace it.

autoDecisions.summary: The verification sections use the verified release versions: connector connect v0.75.0, one-paste Copy and stdio mcp.json v0.78.0, no-webrtc-egress v0.85.0.
autoDecisions.rationale: git tag --contains on the introducing commits (30d9e498995, fb9b1dc770a, 8cb58a89bca) shows these versions; the issue said one-paste shipped in 0.76.0.

items.title: Add integrations/shared/sync-core-pins.mjs with fixture tests

expected_outputs: sync-core-pins.test.ts reports all fixture cases passed, 0 failed

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5486.md W-1 exactly. Create integrations/shared/sync-core-pins.mjs in the style of integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs (parseArgs with --check and --root, exit 2 with a usage line on anything else, default root two levels up from the script). Read the root package.json version (semver with an optional prerelease suffix, else exit 1). Walk integrations/ skipping directories node_modules, dist, build, .venv, venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .git and files named package-lock.json. Rewrite only the version group of /(@overdeck\/core@)(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)/g and /(OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION:-)(same semver)(\})/g. --check prints '✗ <path>:<line> pins <found>, expected <version>' per drift and exits 1; exits 1 with '✗ no core pins found under integrations/' when none exist; otherwise prints '✓ <n> core pins match <version>'. Sync prints 'updated <path>' per changed file and 'core pins: <n> at <version>, <k> file(s) updated'. The script's comments must not contain @overdeck/core@ followed by a digit. Write the fixture tests named in W-1 (spawnSync like sync-skill.test.ts, mkdtemp fixture roots removed in afterEach). Do NOT add the repository-level test here; core-pin-stamp adds it after stamping.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5486.md W-3. After the 'Shared skill copies match' step in the integrations job of .github/workflows/ci.yml, add a step named 'Core pins match the package version' running `node integrations/shared/sync-core-pins.mjs --check`, and add one comment line above `integrations:` naming PAN-5486. Do this item LAST, after every other item is pushed. IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT (the push): push normally first; if refused with 'refusing to allow an OAuth App to create or update workflow', retry with `git push git@github.com:eltmon/overdeck.git HEAD:feature/pan-5486`, then `git fetch origin`. Fallback if both are refused: the commit is local and unpushed, so `git reset --mixed HEAD~1` and `git restore .github/workflows/ci.yml` (no pushed history is rewritten), then `pan task block core-pin-ci-step` with the reason, `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator` that the ci.yml step needs an operator push, and say so in the PR description; core-pin-stamp's repository-level test still satisfies FR-2.
